Wallkill Town Court is situated in Orange County, New York and is one of the busiest courts in that town. It is also known as Wallkill Justice Court. This court handles civil matters, traffic infractions, vehicle violations, Parking, Small claims and criminal cases. Their website gives a schedule for a court date, and the time is available in the court calendar.

Division of Wallkill Town Court

Wallkill Town Court Division consists of the following:

  • Criminal Division
  • Traffic Division
  • Civil Division

How to find case records?

Wallkill Town Court case search can be done online using the first and last name, city, state and date of birth. Some confidential case information is unavailable online, and you must submit a form to the clerk's office if you want that information.

How to make a payment?

Wallkill Town Court payment can be made in the following ways:

In-Person

A person can make payment by visiting the court during business hours and paying in cash or with a card at the counter. Service fees of 2.99% are charged if you are using a credit card for payment.

Online

A person can pay online by using townofwallkill.com or govpaynow.com. Service fees are applied through an online method.

Mail

A Person can send a certified check to the court's mailing address. The mailing address is 99 Tower Drive – Bldg. B Middletown, NY 10941. Persona checks are not accepted.

What types of cases are handled by the Traffic Court?

Wallkill Town Court Traffic court hears and solves cases related to traffic-related matters like speeding, accidents, violation and many more. If you receive a speeding ticket, you must send a plea of guilty or not guilty before the date written on the ticket. You should hire a specialized traffic attorney for this case. If you cannot agree to disposition, the case will be rescheduled again, and a date will be given to you.

see also Denton Municipal Court

What types of cases are handled by the Criminal Division?

Wallkill Town Court Criminal Court hears and solves cases related to criminal matters like murder, kidnapping and many more. In criminal cases, you must appear on the court date with your attorney, and you cannot enter a guilty plea for these types of cases. All charges are prosecuted by the district attorney in the criminal court.

How to pay for the ticket?

Wallkill Town Court pays tickets can be online by visiting the court during business hours, paying online through the court-given website or mailing the certified amount checks to the court.

How to plead guilty?

To write a guilty plea, fill section A, sign your name and send it to the court. The court will reply to you by mail with the acceptable amount and the deadline.

How to plead not guilty?

To write a guilty plea, fill section B, sign your name, enter your phone number, and send it to the court. The court will respond to you by mail. If your ticket does not have a supporting Deposition and you want to receive one from the office, check yes in the section B box.

What types of cases are handled by the Criminal Division?

Wallkill Town Court Criminal Court hears and solves cases related to criminal matters like murder, kidnapping and many more. In criminal cases, you must appear on the court date with your attorney, and you cannot enter a guilty plea for these types of cases. All charges are prosecuted by the district attorney in the criminal court.

What type of cases are handled by the Civil Division?

Wallkill Town Court Civil Court deals with all the cases that citizens will not be able to solve on their own. This division also handles small claims cases. This court handles small claims cases of value up to $3000. The person you are suing must be a resident or had a business in Wallkill Town.

How to get a marriage license?

Wallkill Town Court's marriage license will be provided by the town clerk's office. The fee for the license is $40. The couple must fill out the form online or visit the court to fill it out. The couple's age must be 18+, and a photo identification card like a passport or driving license is mandatory for getting the license.

see also Georgetown DE Family Court

What is the responsibility of the Town Clerk?

The town clerk is the town government hub. Its responsibilities are:

  • Responsibility of Record Management Officer
  • Duty of Clerk to Town Board
  • Filing and License Officer Responsibility
  • Responsibility for Vital Statistics
  • Responsibility for marriage ceremonies performed at Town Hall

When appearing in court is necessary?

A person's appearance in court is mandatory for criminal or small cases. In traffic cases, you can write a plea of guilty or not guilty, and then the court will reply if an appearance is necessary. In some cases, you only had to pay a fine.

FAQ

How can I see my criminal history?

Contact the Record Review Unit or visit the www.criminaljustice.ny.gov website to see your criminal history.

Phone: 518-474-9847

What are the fees for small claims cases?

Wallkill Town Court's small claims case fee is $10 for claims up to $1000 and $15 for claims greater than $1000.

How to contact the court clerk?

Wallkill Town Court Clerk's phone number is 845-692-7826, and you can call them or visit the clerk's office during business hours for any information.

What is Wallkill Town Hall?

Wallkill Town Hall is located in building A of 99 Tower Drive, and it provides many services to the Wallkill town residents. Contact them if you want any service or information.

Phone: 845-692-7800

What are eviction fees?

The fee for filing an eviction case is $20.

What happens if I do not pay for a ticket on time?

If you do not pay the ticket, an extra fine will be added to your ticket fees, or your license will be suspended.

Why do I have to pay surcharges?

It is a mandatory fee forced by the New York state. It must be paid on every ticket.

What are Speeding tickets?

Wallkill Town Court Speeding tickets are the fines and points deduction if a person does some traffic violations. For example, speeding over 1-10 mph on the first offense will fine you $143-$243, and 1 point will be deducted. If you lose many issues, then your license will be suspended.

I cannot make it to Court because I am working. Can I send it to my husband?

No, you cannot send your husband your appearance is mandatory. The person who received a ticket will appear for the case.

How do I file a Civil by myself for back rent?

It would help if you went to www.nycourthelp.gov. All instructions and forms are available; you can use this information to file your civil case.
